title: Nero the Talking Dog

subtitle.text: Nero was bored.
He was also hungry.
He saw Dr. Shady in the lab.
She was his best—well, his only—friend.
"Can I have some Doggie Doodles?" Nero asked.
"No!" Dr. Shady snapped.
"I'm busy working on my evil plan."
Nero gasped. "Your evil plan?"
The scientist smiled. "I made you talk.
Next I'll make every dog talk.
They'll tell their owners what to do.
With your help, I'll take over the world!"
Nero frowned. "I won't help you do that."
Dr. Shady laughed. "You have to.
Why else would I keep you?"
"Because we're best friends?" Nero said.
"Ha!" Dr. Shady shook a test tube.
"I need a real friend," Nero thought.
"Somebody who's nice and feeds me Doggie Doodles.
Hmm . . ."
Nero grabbed a pair of Dr. Shady's shoes.
"Grr!" He ripped them to shreds!
"Argh!" Dr. Shady stamped her foot. "Those
were my favorite slippers!" Dr.
Shady tossed Nero outside. Nero
grinned. "My plan worked!" He
ran to the fence and started digging. Dr.
Shady grabbed his tail. "I got you!" Nero
kicked back hard. "Oof!" He
squeezed under the fence and ran. Dr.
Shady shook her fist. "Get back here!" Nero
ran into town and hid. There
was no sign of Dr. Shady. Nero
curled up and fell asleep. When
Nero woke up, he saw a friendly-looking boy. "Hi!
I'm Nero—can I live with you? I'm
hiding from an evil scientist." The
boy gasped. "You talk ?"
"Yes! And I'm starving," Nero said.
"Do you have any Doggie Doodles?"
The boy scratched his head. "I have carrots . . ."
"Good enough!" Nero said.
"I'm Dev," the boy said. "But, um . . .
What was that about an evil scientist?"
In Dev's kitchen Nero gobbled up carrots.
He explained Dr. Shady's evil plan.
Dev shook his head. "Are you sure that's true?"
"Yes! She made me talk," Nero said.
"And she wants to make other dogs—" "Dev?"
"Who's
that?" Nero squeaked. "My
dad," Dev said. "Follow me!" Dev
pointed to a pile of stuffies on his bed. "Hide
under there!" Nero
grinned. "Hide-and-seek!" "No,
it's just hide !" Dev said.
Nero slid under the stuffies.
Dad came in. "Who are you talking to?"
"Er, nobody," Dev said.
Nero saw a big carrot. "Yum!"
He tried to take a bite. "Yuck! Too fuzzy!"
Dad yanked the stuffie away. "Is
that a real dog—and did he say 'fuzzy'?" "Oops!"
Nero thought. Dev
laughed nervously. "I didn't hear anything." Dad
frowned. "Where's his owner?" "No,
don't look for Dr. Shady!" Nero thought. "He's
lost," Dev said quickly. "Please,
can we keep him?" Dad
sighed. "If we can't find his owner. Let's
get a leash." At
the pet shop, Dev slipped a harness on Nero. Nero
wiggled his butt. "Looking good!" Dev smiled
and scratched Nero's ears. They walked
to the park. "Dev is
nice," Nero thought. "He scratches
my ears and gives me treats." Just then
the mayor walked by. "What a cute dog!" Nero grinned.
Suddenly his
eyes got big. "Squirrel!" Dad squinted.
"Did he just say 'squirrel'?" "No, he
said, ' woof '!" Dev said.
Nero slipped out of his harness and chased the squirrel.
"Stop!" Dev and Dad chased Nero. Dev
ran as fast as he could. "Come back, Nero!" "No,
come to me !"
A woman jumped out of a bush.
Nero gasped. "Dr. Shady!"
Her eyes flashed red. "I'm going to get you!"
Nero dodged Dr. Shady.
Dev raced after Nero. "That's Dr. Shady?
We have to lose her!"
"No kidding!" Nero said. "She's right on our tails!
Well, my tail anyway!"
They saw a merry-go-round.
"Let's hide on that merry-go-round!" Dev said.
They jumped onto the ride.
Nero and Dev went round and round.
They saw Dr. Shady looking for them!
"There you are!" The scientist grabbed at Nero.
"Gotcha! Nope, missed! Gotcha! Nope . . ."
She grabbed a bar and pulled herself up. "I'm on!"
"And we're off!" Nero said.
He and Dev hopped onto a paddleboat.
"Hello!" The mayor waved from another paddleboat.
But then . . .
Nero gulped. "Dr. Shady's coming! Pedal faster!"
"Help me!" Dev said.
"My paws can't reach the pedals," Nero said.
Nero stuck his paws in the water and paddled.
"Ahh! Feels nice!"
He lapped up water. "Tastes nice too!" Dev
scowled. "Stop, Nero, you're tipping the—" Splash!
They fell in the lake. "Swim
to shore!" Dev yelled. Dr.
Shady pedaled toward them. "You
can't swim faster than my paddleboat!" Suddenly—
crash!
"Hey, lady!" the mayor yelled. "You hit my paddleboat!"
On land, Dev and Nero raced down a hill.
Nero tumbled and rolled. "Whee!"
"Oof!" Dev tripped and rolled too.
At the bottom of the hill, Nero panted. "We lost her!"
Suddenly a hand gripped him.
"Nope!" Dr. Shady said.
"I'm right here. And you're coming with me."
The mayor rushed over. "Isn't that Dev's dog?"
Dr. Shady sneered. "It's my dog."
Nero gulped as she gripped him tighter.
"I saw Dev walking him earlier," the mayor said.
"Yes!" Dev nodded. "He's my pet."
Nero shook. "Save me, Dev!" he thought.
"Don't let her take me!"
Nero held his breath.
The mayor looked from Dr. Shady to Dev.
"I'm going to let the dog choose."
"Huh?" Dr. Shady said.
"Huh?" Dev said.
"Huh? Um, woof?" Nero said.
"Follow me!" The mayor took them to a field.
"Dev, stand there."
He pointed to the opposite end. "Miss, please stand there.
Now both of you, call Nero."
"Nero!" Dr. Shady yelled.
"Nero!" Dev yelled.
With his tail wagging, Nero ran toward Dev.
"I'm coming!"
Then a familiar sound caught his ear. Crinkle! Crackle!
Nero froze. "Is that what I think it is?"
He sniffed the air. "Doggie Doodles!"
Dr. Shady shook the bag. Crinkle! Crackle!
"Look, Nero! Doodles! Oodles of Doodles!"
Nero spun around—and bolted toward Dr. Shady!
"No, Nero!" Dev yelled. "Don't do it!"
"Yes, Nero!" Dr. Shady yelled. "Do it!"
Nero tried to stop, but his feet kept going.
"Nero!" Dev's eyes filled with tears. "What about our friendship?"
Nero skidded to a stop.
He thought of Dev's sunny kitchen.
He thought of Dev's scratching his ears.
Dr. Shady waved a Doodle. "Nero, come!
Nero remembered the lonely science lab.
He remembered the evil plan.
Nero spun around and ran.
He jumped on Dev. "Best friends forever!"
"Argh!" Dr. Shady flung the Doodles to the ground.
"Nero is Dev's now," the mayor said.
"Unless Nero changes his mind later."
Dr. Shady stomped off. "He's mine and I'll get him back!"
Dad appeared, huffing and puffing.
"Whew! That was some chase!
Dev, I'm glad you caught Nero.
I guess we have a new pet."
Dev grinned. "Ready to go home, Nero? Er, Nero?"
Chomp! Chomp! Chomp!
Nero looked up, his mouth stuffed with Doodles. "Ready!"
Rain was pouring down.
Nero and Dev were inside, playing charades.
"My turn!" Nero hopped and rolled around the living room.
Dev tapped his chin. "Are you a hot potato?"
Nero's tail wagged. "Yes!"
Dev pumped his fist. "Guessed it!"
Dad stomped in, waving a slipper.
"Someone chewed holes in this!"
Nero gulped.
"And that's not all." Dad led them into the kitchen.
Mud covered the floor.
Nero hid his face with a paw.
"Oh, um, that was me," Dev said quickly.
Dad pointed to the prints. "Do you have paws, Dev?"
Dev sighed. "No."
"Someone was also eating the trash again," Dad said.
Nero burped.
Dad turned to Dev. "Nero needs training.
He's going to a class at Pam's K9 Academy."
"Dog school!" Nero thought.
"Dev has to sit at a desk all day at school . . .
I can't do that!"
"But Nero is already trained," Dev said. "Watch this!"
Dev looked at Nero. "Sit!"
"Easy-peasy!" Nero thought.
He lowered his back end to the floor.
But then a bird shot past the window.
Nero charged over. "Woof! Woof!"
Dad frowned and folded his arms.
Dev sighed. "Fine. I'll take Nero to school."
Pam's K9 Academy had a big yard.
It also had lots of toys.
"This doesn't look too bad," Nero thought.
Just then a disk flew past them.
A big dog jumped up and caught the disk.
"Cool!" Dev said.
"Fun!" Nero thought.
Next the big dog zoomed off on a skateboard.
Dev's eyes lit up. "He's amazing!"
"Hmpf!" Nero said. "He's not that amazing."
The big dog did more tricks.
"That dog is incredible!" Dev said.
Nero rolled his eyes. "I bet he can't . . . Dev?"
Nero gasped.
Dev was petting the dog!
A young woman walked over to Dev. "I'm Pam.
This big dog is Duke."
Dev smiled. "I'm Dev, and this is Nero."
Nero wagged his tail.
Soon other people and dogs arrived.
The class started.
"A dog and its owner form a bond," Pam said.
"A good bond comes from good communication."
Pam looked at Duke. "Sit."
Duke sat.
"Stay." Duke stayed.
Nero rolled his eyes. "Anyone can do that."
"Speak," Pam said.
Duke barked. "Woof!"
Nero chuckled. "[i@That's@i] not—"
"Shh!" Dev held a finger to his mouth.
Nero looked down. "Dev thinks Duke is incredible.
Well, I can be incredible too!"
Pam started explaining more commands for dogs.
Nero ran to a tunnel.
"Nero! That's not for this class!" Pam called.
Nero didn't listen.
Instead he dived into the tunnel.
"Wait till Dev sees this!" he thought.
The tunnel got bunched up and twisted.
"Grr!" Nero dragged himself out of it.
Next he ran to a hoop and tried to jump through.
But the hoop fell over. [i@Crash!@i]
The sound startled Nero, and he bolted.
"Nero, come!" Dev yelled.
But Nero ran up a seesaw.
The seesaw tilted.
"Nero, come!" Dev yelled.
Nero took a step, but the seesaw wobbled.
Nero froze. "How do I get down?"
Duke ran over. "Woof!"
"He's asking if I need help," Nero thought.
Nero barked back. "No thanks! I'm good!"
But the big dog pushed on the seesaw anyway.
"Oof!" Nero slid down and tumbled.
Everyone—even Dev—laughed.
Nero felt awful.
Dev and Pam came over.
"Are you okay, Nero?" Dev asked.
"No!" Nero thought.
Pam shook her head. "You two have poor communication."
Nero's heart sank. "That means our bond isn't good."
Nero barked—and took off running!
"Nero ran into the woods!" Dev said.
"Nero! Come!"
"Duke can find him," Pam said. "Fetch!"
The big dog took off.
Nero was exploring the woods.
Leaves rustled.
He sniffed. "Ugh! Duke is coming!"
Nero hid under a log.
Duke barked. "Woof! Woof!"
"I'm not telling you where I am," Nero thought.
But Nero didn't need to.
Duke found him anyway.
"Grr!" Nero sprinted away, and Duke followed.
"Leave me alone!" Nero thought.
He made a sharp turn through tall grass.
[i@Splurk!@i] He landed in a puddle of mud.
Duke jumped into the mud. [i@Sploomf!@i]
Duke barked again. "Woof!"
Nero gasped. "He wants to be friends.
Nero barked to say, "Let's play!"
The two dogs rolled in the mud.
They splashed and wrestled.
They snapped their teeth—but not too hard.
Then they started chasing each other.
"This is fun!" Nero thought.
The two friends tumbled and slid.
Nero bumped into a tree. [i@Bam!@i]
Duke kept sliding—into a muddy ditch!
Duke slid under a log and yelped. "Arf!"
Nero gasped. "You've hurt your leg!"
"Woof!" Nero barked. "I'll get help!"
He ran back toward the school.
Nero saw Dev coming into the woods.
"Dev!" Nero yelled. "I need—oops!"
Nero slapped a paw over his mouth.
Pam was with Dev.
The trainer looked around. "Did someone call your name?"
Dev bit his lip. "Um, I don't think so."
He clipped the leash onto Nero's harness.
"You're covered in mud. Where's Duke?"
"Duke will be fine," Pam said.
"He's perfectly trained and will come back soon."
"No, he won't!" Nero thought.
He tried to pull Dev toward Duke.
"No, Nero," Dev said. "We're going back to school."
Nero didn't know what to do.
"I can't talk in front of Pam," Nero thought.
"But Duke needs help—fast!"
